# AMC Aurora

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A bright, airy style: an aurora gradient header from deep teal to violet, a soft cool page, crisp white regions with a faint top glow and a teal primary.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_aurora.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-aurora.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-aurora.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-aurora` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita. The header and the current menu entry use an aurora gradient from teal to violet; regions are white with a soft cool shadow; the primary color is a deep teal that passes WCAG AA with white text. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
